name: ielts-vocabulary-coach
title_zh: 雅思单词不止背释义，连搭配和写作例句一起喂给你
tagline_zh: 查一个词，拿到的不只是中文意思——还有它常跟谁搭配、写作里怎么用、口语里怎么换着说。
tagline_en: One word in, full picture out: meanings, collocations, and how to actually use it in IELTS Writing & Speaking.
desc_en: Explain English vocabulary for IELTS learners in depth, especially when the user asks to memorize a word, learn IELTS vocabulary, or provides one or more words for usage, collocations, writing, or speaking.
why_zh: 它不满足于给释义，而是按雅思四项场景拆解用法：写作搭配、口语替换、常见误用。
why_en: It doesn't stop at definitions—it breaks each word down for IELTS Writing & Speaking: natural collocations, alternatives, and.
limit_zh: 只覆盖雅思学术词汇的深度讲解，不包含听力/阅读真题练习，也不生成完整作文或口语答案；需要你主动提问某个词或一组词。
limit_en: Covers in-depth explanations of IELTS academic vocabulary only—no listening/reading practice, no full essay or speaking answers. It responds only.
title_en: IELTS words with collocations & writing-ready examples
